column1: # Book 6 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No findings, no secondaries. The plague read in full against the Latin and Thucydides 2.47-54 in mind; the Opus draft keeps the plain register (nervi = sinews at 6.1161, 6.1190, 6.1206; anima = spirit at 6.1223, 6.1234, 6.1261; religio = religion at 6.1271; mens beside animus = thought at 6.1183), and no modern medical term was found. 6.1225 certabant = vied. Band: 6.1141, 6.1166, 6.1199, 6.1211, 6.1225, 6.1262, 6.1271, 6.1275, 6.1277.

column2: For coming from deep within, risen in the borders of Egypt,
and all the body at once reddened with ulcers as if burned in,
If any of them, as happens, had escaped death's funeral,
yet in life, and some lost the lights of their eyes.
Vast funerals, unattended, vied to be hurried away,
and through the people's open places and streets everywhere
For now neither the gods' religion nor their divine power
for the whole people, in confusion, was in alarm, and each
And the sudden crisis and horrid poverty urged many things;
